neighbours.label: the token ' less', ' Less' or 'Less', as opposed to ' more' and other comparatives
fire: The jacket costs less than $20 at the outlet.
The tiger is less often seen in the north.
Her notes were cut to less than a page.
Less than an hour after the call, he arrived.
Less is more when it comes to salt.
Our team spent less money this year.
With less rain, the river fell.
He is a friend of Dr. Lesslie from school.
quiet: The jacket costs more than $20 at the outlet.
The tiger is often seen in the north.
Her notes were copied onto a page.
Just an hour after the call, he arrived.
Salt is good when it comes to soup.
Our team spent more money this year.
With heavy rain, the river rose.
He is a friend of Dr. Lewis from school.

notes: ' reduced' reached 0.19 in a probe; the near misses avoid it.
